Synopsis:
Eroll was already having a bad day, considering he is the poor impaled soul in the Smuggler’s Cave who’s begging you to help the guild members fighting the Stone Man’s men.  After said begging, he actually dies in front of your eyes.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_OrinsImpersonation_OrinDyingAttacker.json: The scene takes place in the Smuggler’s Cave amid a skirmish between the Smugglers’ Guild and forces aligned with the Stone Man: Eroll (the impaled man) is found pinned on a makeshift stake, pleading for aid and begging the player to help his comrades. Despite the player's attempts or offers to heal him, Eroll insists no cure will work and asks to be put out of his misery — then dies before your eyes. His anguished, oddly gleeful demeanor as he dies implies something uncanny or deceptive at work (the game’s assets link this beat to a wider “Orin impersonation” thread), but nothing in the exchange requires knowing exactly who — if anyone — is manipulating him. context: The scene is set in the Smuggler’s Cave during a short, brutal skirmish between the Smugglers’ Guild (the attackers) and forces aligned with the Stone Man, with the city already unraveling off‑screen. Eroll — an injured man pinned to a piece of driftwood with a blade through his belly — pleads for aid, begs you to help his comrades, and insists that no potion or spell can save him; he urges you to remove the blade and end his life. The player is presented with immediate moral choices (comfort him, grant a mercy kill, or torment him), but Eroll dies before long. His anguished, oddly gleeful manner as he dies hints at something uncanny (the scene is tied to an Orin‑impersonation thread), though the lines themselves don’t require you to know who might be manipulating him.
